text: 下面进入小作文 04 · 邀请与感谢信：邀请外籍教授担任英语演讲比赛评委答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：代表组织发出正式而热情的邀请。
On behalf of the Student Union, I am honored to extend a cordial invitation to you to serve as an expert judge.
加分表达：extend a cordial invitation 替换 invite you warmly。
第二段：交待活动要素并对受邀者的学术声望给予崇高评价。
Considering your outstanding academic prestige and linguistic insight, your professional evaluation would undoubtedly inspire all contestants.
赞誉客套经典句：Considering your profound insight, your presence would elevate the caliber of this competition.
Your commentary would elevate the academic caliber of this competition.
第三段：礼貌致谢并提醒日程确认时限。
We would be deeply grateful if you could accept our invitation, and please kindly notify us of your availability before this Wednesday.
客气礼貌虚拟语气：We would be deeply grateful if you could accept our invitation.
We would be deeply grateful if you could accept our invitation.
